The Brakpan Paedophile Colin Genricks

By: Sasha Schwendenwein | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Convicted Paedophile Colin Genricks is at it again. We have witnesses and young men who say he has had sex with them - boys ranging from 12-18.

Summary:
In Brakpan, Gert Minnie walked in on his business partner - Colin Genricks having sex with a young boy. He went to the police and laid a complaint. He then Googled Gert and found out he had been convicted of having sex with 10 children in 2002 while he was a scout leader. I will approach Magistrate Elmarie Schutte in Benoni Court and ask her for her judgement and see if she would be willing to speak on the matter. As she is still a magistrate, I think this unlikely, however she may be willing to speak about the matter and point me in the direction of who can speak.
http://mini.iol.co.za/news/south-africa/scout-leader-admits-to-sex-with-boys-89761


I also see that Colin had a psychiatrist who spoke about his upbringing and how he himself was raped as a 13 year old boy by a female while on a scout tour. The Psychiatrist Dr. Lynette Roux has since been struck from the HPCSA's roll because of unprofessional conduct: https://lynetteroux.wordpress.com/2014/12/18/judgement-against-dr-lynette-roux-for-unprofessional-conduct/ and http://www.saflii.org/za/cases/ZASCA/2011/135.html

We were able to obtain the entire record of the original trial and Luke Lamprecht was an original witness. We are going to try and get an original victim to speak... and the family who lived with Colin before are willing to speak about how their children were abused.


Further information:
Gert initially met Colin in 2010 and they went into business together (construction business). When he walked in on Colin and realized he was previously convicted he made a police case. (He is willing to make an affidavit that this is not a sour business relationship and will show us what financials he has.) When Colin found out Gert went to the police, he forced a young man to go to the police and lay a false allegation against Gert. Gert will be in court today, and the charges will be dropped, as the young man has since recanted and said Colin forced him (we have audio recordings of this).

Currently Gert lives with a women named Mary Marais - who has 3 children. The oldest in 18, the next is Deon Marais (14), Anton (11). There is another boy Donovan van der walt, 15, (a neighbor's child) who gert walked in on. Colin having a family live with him is something that has happened before. Previously the Chester Family lived there, Colin allegedly abused those children. This was reported to the police and colin evicted the family, so that Mary Marais (a widow) could move in with her boys. We have those affidavits.

As none of the children can speak this makes it difficult for us, we will use their affidavits and tell their stories through visuals and actors voices.

Press Release:


No Justice for Children
He was convicted of sex crimes with children under 16, but re-offended after his release. How did a known paedophile gain access to children for a second time? Carte Blanche asks why the justice system is failing to protect children from convicted paedophiles.


Script:


IN 2009 THE DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE IMPLEMENTED A SEX OFFENDER REGISTER TO HELP PREVENT CONVICTED OFFENDERS COMING INTO CONTACT WITH CHILDREN. IN A STORY LAST YEAR CARTE BLANCHE EXPOSED A TEACHER – COLIN CHAPMAN - WHO WAS NOT PICKED UP ON THE SEX OFFENDER REGISTER WHILE WORKING AT A SCHOOL IN DURBAN.
NTOMBI: “We’ve got 22,729 sex offenders registered.
NTOMBI MATJILA MONITORS THE REGISTER. SHE SAYS PARENTS MUST CHECK EVERYONE AGAINST THE REGISTER WHO HAS CONTACT WITH THEIR CHILDREN. AS IT’S NOT PUBLIC, SOME PARENTS MAY NOT KNOW THIS AND LAST MONTH A CONVICTED SEX OFFENDER WAS RE-ARRESTED AFTER SLIPPING THROUGH THE CRACKS.
COLIN AUBREY GENRICKS, A BOY SCOUT LEADER, WAS CONVICTED OF MULTIPLE SEX CRIMES IN 2002.
Daniel: “He had a lot of special boys. We were all special boys.”
DANIEL VAN RENSBURG WAS BETWEEN 14 AND 17 WHEN COLIN ENGAGED IN WEEKLY SEX SESSIONS WITH HIM AFTER SCHOOL.
Daniel: “You were now in the I can’t tell anyone group, because then everyone will know what happened, and there’s shame and guilt attached to that.”
CLINICAL PSYCHIATRIST DR. GERARD LABUSCHAGNE EXPLAINS THAT GROOMING A CHILD IS THE LAST PART OF THE PROCESS.
Gerard: “You entrench yourself in the community as a figure beyond reproach. Isolate the child using alcohol, marijuana...im going to get in trouble if I go ahead and report this sexual behaviour because I was also doing something bad.”
CHILD PROTECTION EXPERT LUKE LAMPRECHT TESTIFIED IN COLIN’S TRIAL.
Luke: “His denial around his responsibility – which is one of the big things offenders do - was profound.
COLIN WAS CONVICTED OF 12 COUNTS OF SEX CRIMES INVOLVING 10 BOYS OR YOUNG MEN AGED BETWEEN 11 AND 18.
DEVI LINK:
FOUR OF THOSE ACCOUNTS WERE INDECENT ASSAULT, THE YOUNGEST VICTIM WAS JUST 11 YEARS OLD.
THE OTHER 8 COUNTS CONTRAVENED THE IMMORALITY ACT - BASICALLY, THAT COLIN ENGAGED IN HOMOSEXUAL ACTS WITH BOYS UNDER THE AGE OF 19. THE AGE OF CONSENT IN 2002 FOR HOMOSEXUAL ACTS WAS 19, BUT THIS WAS RULED UNCONSITUTIONAL IN 2008 AND THE AGE OF CONSENT FOR SEX REGARDLESS OF SEXUAL PREFERENCE IS NOW 16.
COLIN WAS SENTENCED TO 20 YEARS IN PRISON, 8 OF WHICH WERE SUSPENDED. MAGISTRATE ANNAMARIE SCHUTTE FOUND COLIN’S CONDUCT “HORRIBLE” BECAUSE HE CLAIMED HE WAS SEDUCED BY THE CHILDREN.”
COLIN APPEALED, BUT THE PRETORIA HIGH COURT UPHELD THE CONVICTIONS. HOWEVER THE SENTENCE WAS REDUCED FROM 12 YEARS IMPRISONMENT TO 7.
NTOMBI SAYS PREVIOUSLY RAPE WAS NOT A CRIME THAT COULD BE PERPETRATED AGAINST A MAN.
NTOMBI: “The act brought into being a wider scope of the definition of rape, if it were now, he would have been convicted of a sexual offense.”
Luke:” He is absolutely a sexual predator, who sexually assaulted, and under the new law raped boys.”
THE COURT DID HOWEVER ADVISE THAT SUCH A PERSON SHOULD NEVER COME INTO CONTACT OR WORK WITH CHILDREN.
THE CORRECTIONAL SERVICES DEPARTMENT SAYS COLIN SPENT THREE YEARS AND 8 MONTHS IN PRISON BEFORE HE WAS RELEASED ON PAROLE.
Daniel: “I spent the next 5 years of my life in therapy. How does that happen? How do you go from a 20 year sentence.2 years is almost life.”
COLIN’S PROBATION LASTED THREE YEARS DURING WHICH HE MOVED TO BRAKPAN AND LATER STARTED A CONSTRUCTION BUSINESS. ACCORDING TO WITNESSES, IN 2015 HE ALLEGEDLY BEGAN HIRING LOCAL TEENAGERS – AS YOUNG AS 14 - TO WORK FOR HIM.
NTOMBI SAYS COLIN BROKE THE LAW BY EMPLOYING CHILDREN.
NTOMBI: “It is illegal, because the act says a convicted person may not work with them.”
DEVI LINK: “Then in February this year Colin found himself back in court, this time its alleged he sexually molested a 15-year old boy. Colin was granted bail of R10,000.”
THE LAW PROTECTS SEXUAL ABUSE VICTIMS UNDER 16 AND THEIR FAMILIES FROM BEING IDENTIFIED BY THE MEDIA. CARTE BLANCHE DRAMATIZED WHAT THEY SAY HAPPENED TO THEM USING WITNESS STATEMENTS AND AFFIDAVITS. ALL THEIR NAMES HAVE BEEN CHANGED.
“BEN”, WHO WAS 14 IN 2015, MADE A NEW SCHOOL FRIEND OF THE SAME AGE WHO INVITED HIM TO HIS HOUSE.
BEN: “One weekend he kept on asking me, “please come and visit me.”
AND THAT’S WHEN HE MET COLIN. COLIN SAYS IN AFFIDAVITS HE’S JOHN’S “FOSTER FATHER.”3 FAMILIES INCLUDING JOHN’S MOTHER AND TWO BROTHERS, ONE OF WHO, IS ONLY 11 ALL LIVE WITH COLIN.
NTOMBI SAYS ITS UNLAWFUL FOR A CONVICTED SEX OFFENDER TO LIVE WITH CHILDREN.
BEN: “I saw that Collin smoked weed...everybody smoked weed in that house.”
BEN SAID HIS PARENTS WERE STRUGGLING FINANCIALLY AND HE BEGAN WORKING FOR COLIN. SOON, COLIN OFFERED HIM A PLACE TO STAY TEMPORARILY. SHORTLY AFTER MOVING IN, DURING THE NIGHT BEN ALLEGES COLIN SEXUALLY ASSAULTED AND RAPED HIM ON NUMEROUS OCCASIONS.
“He whispers in your ear, ‘lay still’.
BEN ALLEGES COLIN MOLESTED JOHN AND HIS 11 YEAR OLD BROTHER TOO. WHEN HE FINALLY TOLD HIS FATHER OUT OF SHEAR DESPERATION FORMAL CHARGES WERE LAID AGAINST COLIN.
THEN THREE WEEKS LATER, ANOTHER CASE WAS OPENED AGAINST COLIN. IT WAS ALLEGED HE HAD GROOMED TWO BOYS AGED 6 AND 7 BACK IN 2013. THEIR MOTHER, “SHARON”SAYS SHE AND HER HUSBAND WORKED FOR HIS CONSTRUCTION BUSINESS AND LIVED IN HIS HOUSE.
NTOMBI SAYS COLIN SHOULD HAVE DISCLOSED HIS CONVICTIONS TO SHARON.
“And they can get both a fine and prison sentence.”
SHARON ALLEGES ALARM BELLS RANG WHEN HER 6 YEAR OLD TOLD HER HE WAS WATCHING PORNOGRAPHY WITH COLIN.
Sharon: “He said Colin said they must – when they looked at the movies – Colin said they must pull off their pants. So I start crying.”
DEVI LINK: “Sharon came here to the police station to lay charges of abuse against Colin. She alleges that the police here told her she had no proof, then in February this year, Sharon returned and this time laid formal charges against Colin. But the question remains, why did the police not take her seriously the first time around?”
SEVERAL WITNESSES REPORTED COLIN TO THE BRAKPAN POLICE STATION LAST YEAR. THE POLICE SAY THEY CANNOT COMMENT DURING AN OPEN INVESTIGATION.
WE CALLED COLIN AND HE SAID INITIALLY HE WANTED TO TELL HIS STORY.
CALL: “I mean even though I was convicted, it was ruled unconstitutional.”
COLIN IS REFERRING TO THE SUPREME COURT OF APPEAL CASE WHERE THE AGE OF CONSENT FOR HOMOSEXUAL ACTS WAS LOWERED TO 16. THIS WOULD NOT NULLIFY HIS CONVICTIONS BECAUSE 8 OF THE 10 MINORS WERE UNDER 16.
COLIN THEN TOLD US HE HAD SECOND THOUGHTS ABOUT GRANTING THE INTERVIEW.
Colin: “It’s really upsetting me because I actually really want to speak and tell that side of the story, but my lawyers told me that I mustn’t.”
DURING THE BAIL HEARING FOR BENS CASE COLIN SAID “I was convicted in terms of the immorality act, having sexual relations with a male under the age of 19.”
THE NPA CONFIRMED THEY FAILED TO DOUBLE CHECK THIS AND THEREFORE GRANTED HIM BAIL. WE REQUESTED AN INTERVIEW BUT THEY DECLINED AS THE CASE IS CURRENTLY IN COURT. WE ASKED COLIN WHY HE DID NOT SAY 8 OF THE 10 VICTIMS WERE UNDER 16.
Devi: “The problem is here, that we were talking about children back in 2002?”
Colin: “What?”
Devi: “They were children.”
Colin: “Okay.”
Devi: “I’m just trying to understand why you’re trying to downplay that when the reality is that you were...
Colin: “I’m not trying to downplay that. I mean a... what’s that got to do with this here?
Devi: “You’re a convicted Paedophile Colin, and now you’re being accused of doing it again.
WE WENT UNDERCOVER AND SAW COLIN AT A SCHOOL, PICKING UP CHILDREN.
AT HIS HOUSE WE SAW HIM LEAVE WITH A CHILD IN HIS CAR AND WE ALSO SAW A SCHOOL BUS DROPPING OFF OTHER CHILDREN AT THE SAME HOUSE.
Devi: “The judge in the appeal said that you shouldn’t live or work with children. But you’re living with children and you’re hiring them in your construction business.
Colin: “Okay I have no knowledge of that.”
Devi: “You have no knowledge of that? You don’t have children living in your home?”
Colin: “No, about what you’ve just said about the court.”
Devi: “No it’s there in black and white, did you not read it?”
Colin: “I never got any documentation from that.”
WE ASKED COLIN IF HE’S GUILTY OF THE NEW ALLEGATIONS OF ABUSE.
Colin: “I’m not.”
RELATING TO SHARON’S CHILDREN HE SAYS HE DID NOT KNOW ABOUT THE NEW CHARGES AGAINST HIM.
Colin: “Look i’m not discussing this with you okay.”
COLIN WILL PLEAD NOT GUILTY TO RAPE AND SEXUAL ASSAULT. HIS NEXT APPEARANCE IS ON THE 19 OF APRIL. THE NPA HAD COLIN REARRESTED A FEW WEEKS AGO FOR NOT DISCLOSING THE ENTIRETY OF HIS PREVIOUS CONVICTIONS. ADDED TO THAT, HE WAS FORMALLY CHARGED IN SHARONS CASE. HE WAS RELEASED AGAIN, BUT ON STRICT BAIL CONDITIONS. HIS LAWYER NEL SNYMAN SAYS HIS CLIENT IS INNOCENT UNTIL PROVEN GUILTY. COLIN HAS DECLINED TO COMMENT PUBLICALLY ON BECAUSE IT IS SUB JUDICE AND DISCUSSING IT IN THE MEDIA WILL UNDERMINE HIS RIGHT TO A FAIR TRIAL.
DANIEL: “I’m very shocked... if you’ve been charged for abuse, how do you get access to kids again?”
NTOMBI SAYS PARENTS MUST INSIST ON A CLEARANCE CERTIFICATE FROM ANYONE IN CONTACT WITH THEIR CHILD - THIS INDICATES THAT THE PERSON HAS BEEN CHECKED AGAINST THE SEX OFFENDER REGISTER.
DANIEL ENCOURAGES ANY VICTIM OF SEXUAL ABUSE TO STEP FORWARD.
DANIEL: “You don’t need to be ashamed, you can overcome this. If there are any other victims of Colin’s they must come forward, because then maybe we don’t have to go through this again for a 3rd time.”
